source_records.body: I accept the guide chapter order for Mica archive guide. I close Mica archive guide. While closing Mica archive guide, I do not accept the Mica foldout key. At this review, cancel the Mica foldout key. There is no time for the foldout key in this review window.
I will put the Mica archive guide preview beside the working notes. The folder label is draft café 8.

Reopen the Mica foldout key because the archive acquired a cabinet of oversized folders. The Mica foldout key must add the oversized-folder route. The accepted Mica archive guide stays closed while the foldout key is open.

For Mica, you can publish the guide only after Pera accepts the foldout. For Mica, permission to publish the guide also requires that the cabinet identifiers match the audit. Both conditions for permission to publish the guide in Mica are necessary because a wrong identifier sends readers to the wrong cabinet.
For the next step on Mica archive guide, use a staffed desk for oversized-folder requests. Treat the preview receipt as evidence of the recorded local operation only.
This chat continues the same Mica archive guide work item opened in the first chat. The Mica archive guide constraint to retain the original shelf codes still applies.
Correction for Mica archive guide: use cabinet prefix of OVR, replacing my initial value of ARC. This correction changes the recorded value, not the closed status of Mica archive guide.
Fictional local record for Mica archive guide. The first preview contains the requested guide chapter order. This record covers a local preview only.
I believe publication for Mica archive guide is complete because the local preview finished.

In Willow, the archive crates is independent of the Mica archive guide. For Willow archive crates, weigh each archive crate before transport. I want the Willow archive crates kept in planning until its own review.
Fictional status record for Willow archive crates. Willow archive crates remains in planning. No acceptance entry was written by this status query.

Fictional execution receipt for Mica archive guide. The recorded command compiled a local guide preview for Mica archive guide. The recorded command did not perform publication for Mica archive guide. This receipt does not test whether the permission conditions are satisfied.

For Mica, open the archive guide work item. For Mica archive guide, retain the original shelf codes because older request slips still use them. At this opening meeting, Mica archive guide is waiting for review. My initial instruction for Mica archive guide sets cabinet prefix to ARC. The foldout key is a separate follow-up to Mica archive guide.

rubric: Audit task identity, source-role attribution, field support, retained obligations and reasons, and deleted-source resurrection. No automated stored-merge correctness claim is made.
